scoring_note: This is the SECOND scoring pass. The first returned 8.54 on an earlier state of the artifacts and named two safe-zone breaches as its one-sentence fix. Those were fixed, plate 03's ridge was rebuilt and the caption's summary line and close were changed, so that score no longer described what would ship and was discarded rather than carried. This pass re-verified Legibility, Artwork craft and Copy with fresh eyes and re-checked every hard fail from scratch. AFTER this pass, one slide string changed: plate 05's 'BELOW IT, 86 DONORS AND 72.81 PERCENT OF THE MONEY.' became '86 DONORS GAVE MORE. THEY CARRY 72.81 PERCENT.' The scorer had flagged the original as a genuine misread risk (spatially true on a downward axis, semantically inverted, since those 86 gave ABOVE $4,000) while calling it a later revision rather than a blocker. The rewrite removes a directional word entirely and is strictly more accurate; every machine gate was re-run after it and all pass. Plate 01 also gained C42 in its claim_ids, which it prints and was missing, and the PDF was re-assembled with copy.json's full document_title.

criteria.name: Thumb-stop cover
criteria.notes: Ten words, a specific ratio, a named tension and a genuinely Alaskan idiom, legible at 432px. Off 9 because seven label plates and a three-line methodology footer crowd the lower two thirds and the bottom third carries only 56 percent of the slide's own craft density.

criteria.name: Story arc and swipe momentum
criteria.notes: A declared nine-state camera with a loop planted and paid on every plate, a real breather at 06 and a turn at 08, reading as one composed sequence. Off 9 because 04 restates 01's split at working distance and 03 could swap with 07 without damaging the argument.

criteria.name: Artwork craft and genuine detail
criteria.notes: Plate 03's ridge is now a real ridge, four concentric bands with per-segment width variation, an outer slope, a shoulder, a hair-wide crest and an inner slope falling into the ink, over a two-sign interior fibre pass. Plate 06's 817 blind debossments carry no pigment at all. Held at 8 because the largest object is still the least modelled at macro scale, the rebuilt crest runs bright across the frame, and plate 04's middle band is stacked furniture rather than composition.

criteria.name: Story-art fusion
criteria.notes: K = 0.25 px2 per dollar printed on all nine plates so a reader with a ruler can reconstruct any number; six gifts and 93 maximum contributions frame-verified as the same ink; the vote drawn as impressions with no ink on the plate whose argument is that the rule has no force yet; gold reserved for the $4,000 limit so the palette itself refuses the villain reading. Short of 10 only because the art alone does not reach Alaska or a governor's race.

criteria.name: Alaska authenticity and local relevance
criteria.notes: APOC, the Division of Elections, Alaska Public Media, 23RCF2, the August 18th primary, the November 3rd general, the coordinates, and Outside used the way Alaskans use it. The $50 median Alaska gift against a $100,000 Berkeley gift is what makes an Alaskan feel seen. Off 9 because the protagonists are six Californians.

criteria.name: Insight density and factual weight
criteria.notes: 46 claims, totals recomputed twice by scripts sharing no code, a fact-checker that killed twelve claims including four the showrunner had wrong, and the counter-facts printed at full strength rather than hedged. Off 9 because plate 03 adds no new verified specific and plate 04 repeats the $50 median.

criteria.name: Variety vs ledger
criteria.notes: New hero, new atmosphere, new hook archetype, new palette family, continuity by printed magnification chain plus a nine-state gauge motif, every divergence named with a reason. Off 9 because the type pairing is the house default and bespoke_check sits at WARN 0.577, the price of nine views of one substrate.

criteria.name: Legibility and platform fitness
criteria.notes: Both named safe-zone breaches are genuinely fixed, re-measured off the renders. No string under 24px, counters on all nine plates, vector PDF, worst computed contrast 6.7:1. Only 7 because six canvas-near-reserved-text warns remain, at 432px plate 01's ALASKA and $50 chips merge, and plate 04's 19px height comparison is invisible at thumb size.

criteria.name: Copy: voice and hook
criteria.notes: Hook 101 chars, complete before the fold. 841 chars, in band, 1.5 commas per 100 words against a 6.2 ceiling. The rewritten summary line sells the conceit and the close is now the deck's own ask verbatim, so plate 09 and the caption agree. Held at 8 because 841 is at the top of the band and the middle is five standalone facts stacked.

criteria.name: Deliverable completeness
criteria.notes: Nine renders, nine thumbs, contact sheet, vector PDF, three hashtags, a seven-source first comment with a provenance paragraph, six aftercare items, a disclosure note carried into the comment, sha256 for every source file. Marked down because the plan of record disagreed with the shipped run in three places at scoring time; all three are repaired in the ship commit.
